# Crenel 1.4.1
- **Dictation asks for the access it needs.** Without Accessibility, Crenel could only copy what you said and pointed to its own Settings. Now macOS asks right away, and the notch shows Allow, which opens the right permission for Accessibility, the microphone or Input Monitoring. - **The speech model downloads before your first dictation.** On a new Mac the first tries no longer fail with "isn't installed" or "Downloading". - **The download can't get stuck.** If macOS had no room left for another dictation language, the model never downloaded; Crenel now frees the languages it no longer uses.

# Crenel 1.4
- **Record anything, any time.** One Record button always sits on the top row of Today, with or without a meeting. It also works right after a recording finished, failed or is still being processed. - **Google Meet records without the Chrome extension.** Meet calls are recorded from your Mac's audio and your mic, like any other call. Nothing to click in the Meet tab and nothing to install in the browser; the extension is retired. - **Your mic stays out while you're muted.** Muting yourself in Zoom or Google Meet keeps your mic out of the recording, as before. - **Calendar and Reminders show up as soon as you allow them.** Crenel no longer keeps showing "Allow" after access was granted until you quit and reopen it. - **A local tool.** Crenel records what your Mac plays and your mic, and doesn't notify anyone on the call. Whether you may record, and asking the others, is up to you.

# Crenel 1.3
- **A cleaner, calmer layout everywhere.** The notch, the desktop window and Settings now share one spacing system: lists have room to scan, related things sit together, and every screen lines up on the same edges. - **Easier lists.** Task rows are taller, calendar and recording rows keep their time tile as one tidy column, and section labels show their count beside the name ("Today · 3"). - **Settings on one card per page.** Each setting reads as a title with a short line under it and its control on the right, without a box around every row. - **Roomier task input.** The "Add a task" field is easier to type in.
